I1.definition: I1 = sum_{mu<nu} eta^mu eta^nu <F_mu nu, F_mu nu>_eta, <F,G>_eta = tr(eta F eta G^T), F_mu nu = A_mu eta A_nu - A_nu eta A_mu; = (1/2) F_{mu nu a b} F^{mu nu a b}

I2.definition: I2 = F_{mu nu a b} F^{a b mu nu} (derivative pair of one F contracted with the internal pair of the other; mixed pairs use delta)

I3.definition: I3 = F_{mu nu a b} F^{mu a nu b} (eta on the mu-mu and b-b pairs, delta on the mixed nu-a pairs)

I4.definition: I4 = R_{nu a} R^{nu a} = sum eta_nu eta_a R[nu,a]^2, R[nu,a] = sum_mu F[mu nu a mu]

I5.definition: I5 = R_{nu a} R^{a nu} = sum_{nu a} R[nu,a] R[a,nu], R[nu,a] = sum_mu F[mu nu a mu]

I6.definition: I6 = R^2, R = sum_nu R[nu,nu] = sum_{mu nu} F[mu nu nu mu]

I1_frob.definition: I1_frob = sum_{mu<nu} eta^mu eta^nu tr(F_mu nu F_mu nu^T) (Frobenius internal metric; M5.21.16 variant A; control)

I3_mixed_eta.definition: I3_mixed_eta = sum eta_mu eta_nu eta_a eta_b F[mu nu a b] F[mu a nu b] (eta on the mixed pairs; NON-covariant control)

E1.definition: E1 = F[pqrs] F[xyxy] eps[pqrs] (eps[F1.d0,F1.d1,F1.i2,F1.i3] (F2.d0-F2.i2) (F2.d1-F2.i3); slots 0,1 derivative, 2,3 internal; one Levi-Civita symbol; the R0 rule extended: eps-d eta, eps-i delta)
E1.static_status: vanishes identically on the static sector

E2.definition: E2 = F[pqrx] F[syxy] eps[pqrs] (eps[F1.d0,F1.d1,F1.i2,F2.d0] (F1.i3-F2.i2) (F2.d1-F2.i3); slots 0,1 derivative, 2,3 internal; one Levi-Civita symbol; the R0 rule extended: eps-d eta, eps-i delta)
E2.static_status: vanishes identically on the static sector

E3.definition: E3 = F[pqrx] F[xysy] eps[pqrs] (eps[F1.d0,F1.d1,F1.i2,F2.i2] (F1.i3-F2.d0) (F2.d1-F2.i3); slots 0,1 derivative, 2,3 internal; one Levi-Civita symbol; the R0 rule extended: eps-d eta, eps-i delta)
E3.static_status: vanishes identically on the static sector

I1_h.definition: I1_h = sum_{mu<nu} eta^mu eta^nu tr(h_cov F h_cov F^T), h_cov = eta + 2 (eta u)(eta u)^T, u = timelike unit eigenvector of M eta (contravariant, u^T eta u = -1); = I1_frob in the vacuum eigenframe

J1.definition: J1 = sum_{mu<nu} eta^mu eta^nu tr(F eta M eta F eta M eta) (contravariant F, M joined by eta; tr((FM)^2)-type)

J2.definition: J2 = sum_{mu<nu} eta^mu eta^nu tr(F eta F eta M eta M eta) (tr(F^2 M^2)-type)

Pgrad.definition: Pgrad = sum_mu eta^{mu mu} q(d_mu P_t, d_mu P_t), P_t = u u^T eta, q(X,Y) = sum_ab eta_a eta_b X[a,b] Y[a,b], d_mu u by first-order eigenvector perturbation of M eta along A_mu (the search knob -kappa is the coefficient)
Pgrad.static_status: vanishes identically on the static sector

alpha_sym.definition: notebook jets M_mu = [Gamma_mu, d]_xi at d = diag(g,1,delta,0) (s = -1), spatial symbols free, A_0 = omega a0 per channel; C is a quadratic form in the 18 spatial generator components; sign object = its 18x18 matrix at g = 32, delta = 3/10

alpha_num.definition: vacuum point M = d, 20 random FULL symmetric spatial jets (eigenvalue directions included), A_0 = omega a0 per channel; A/B/C per jet

alpha_lat.definition: M5.21.16 CHAN field (analytic hedgehog, g = 32, s = -1, n = 32, L = 48, sym stencil); a0 = envelope * [G, M] normalized (gen_catalog) for clock_local / boost_z / boost_x; a0 = envelope * (K M + M K) normalized for the Lorentz variants; clock_local_sym = envelope * [J_local, M] normalized (the symmetric tangent)

beta.definition: M5.21.14 analytic boost-dressed twisting hedgehog, toy point (g = 32, delta = 0.3, s = -1), radius set make_grid(48, 8, 16) (r in [0.15, 24]), b*(r) = b_of(avec_record, r); spatial jets by the record's 4-point Richardson; a0 = Qb a0_base Qb^T (the dressed twist generator); control column = undressed b = 0

gamma.definition: 300 random points in 0.5 < r < 6; spatial channels boost_radial (Lorentz boost, rapidity eps tanh(r/2) along r-hat), rot_radial (rotation by eps tanh(r/2) about r-hat), boost_z_scalar (fixed K_z, scalar profile), eig_mix (abelian eigenvalue profiles); time channels a0(M) = K_z M + M K_z (Lorentz), K_z M - M K_z (CHAN reading), J_1 M - M J_1^T (clock), E_00; A, B, C = mean density; order = log2 ratio between successive eps halvings (last pair)
